kind.instructions: Classify this slice brief (a bounded task handed to one worker agent) by the kind of work it asks for. Pick exactly one of the five kinds.

criteria.locate: find where something is — a file, symbol, loader, registration, or set of files; the deliverable is a location or enumeration
criteria.understand: explain or map a surface without changing it — a report, trace, or research write-up that establishes what something is or does
criteria.change-small: edit within a handful of files — a bounded modification, small addition, or one-file artifact
criteria.change-large: a feature or subsystem needing cohesion across many files — a build with several moving parts that must fit together
criteria.judge: a review, ruling, design call, or comparison with no runnable output — the deliverable is a verdict or a critique
